events.title: Application text sent through contact form
events.body:
Speculative application for leather sewing or upholstery employment

Dear Canada's Boss Leather Furniture Team,

I am applying speculatively for a suitable leather sewing or upholstery position. Your description of custom sofa production emphasizes leather selection, cutting, sewing and careful assembly. These operations relate to my experience in Moroccan leather workshops and my wish to continue in furniture manufacturing.

At Leather Citizen in Rabat, I contributed to Jouffre seating commissions involving approximately 20 to 40 metres for the Moulay Abdellah Stadium VIP hall and 10 to 20 metres for Ciné Pathé Rabat. I worked on material preparation, assembly, finishing and quality checks, with attention to the completed seating's appearance.

My garment work at CST Corp Morocco and Leather Citizen includes pattern preparation, machine sewing and inspection to client specifications. Since starting my apprenticeship in the Fadil family workshop in 2006, I have also made footwear, bags and small leather goods and helped train apprentices. I would need to learn your furniture construction and specific tools and machines.

I am a Moroccan national living in Morocco, without Canadian residence or work authorization. My English and French are A2, used at work, and I am willing to improve them for the role. I could relocate and start immediately after the required work authorization and visa are approved. Please advise whether you consider recruitment from Morocco and can support the necessary employer-side process, such as an LMIA or an applicable exemption.

Your contact form has no attachment field. My CV, personalized cover letter and work portfolio with photographs and certificate copies are ready. Please forward this application text to recruitment and provide an email address where I can send the documents. I would appreciate confirmation of the actual workshop location, hours, gross wage and language requirements.

Kind regards,
Mohammed Fadil
+212 603 574 848
mfadil.med@gmail.com
